snippet.title: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
There shall be no absolution.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4444800/Obey_Me_Sinners_Choice_Lucifer/
Wishlist now on Steam ⚖

The brand-new game, Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
Coming to Steam® in 2026!

You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant.
Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel.
Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.
